newsitem.title: USA: Harbor Federal to form holding company.
newsitem.headline: Harbor Federal to form holding company.

text.p: Harbor Federal Savings Bank received regulatory approval to reorganize into a two-tier mutual holding company structure through the establishment of Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc.
In a statement Monday, the company said Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc will become the majority owned subsidiary of Harbor Financial, the bank's mutual holding company.
Each outstanding share of Harbor Federal Savings will be converted into one share of Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc common stock, under the reorganization.
The holding company structure will enable the company to buy back shares without adverse tax consequences, it said.
